interpretation: The clean v2 baseline enforces the training boundary and restores the original detector; it is the first valid gate evaluation for this pool. The prior v1 boundary-exposed ledger is superseded.

The default executable representation fails the pre-registered gate: realized held excess is negative, fixed-40-day Alpha is slightly negative, and only three of seven training years have positive fixed-horizon Alpha.

The pool has a defensive relative-strength profile: fixed-40-day excess is positive in down markets (+1.31 percent) and negative in up markets (-1.52 percent), with overall Alpha close to zero (-0.19 percent).

The right tail is material in absolute terms (4,829 paths above 50 percent MFE and 700 above 100 percent), but the default exits realize little of it: the median exit capture of a 50-percent-MFE path is 3.66 percent. This suggests the failure is partly exit realization, not pure selection.

next_action: Retain as a candidate pool only; do not promote the default executable representation. Before any structural change, reuse this frozen ledger to separate selection quality from exit realization, then pre-register one structural exit or entry hypothesis.
